task: Lift, carry and place a clothes stand
protocol: Selected trials from one recorded 30-minute Codex session. Curves are reconstructed from score-verified replays. Images and excerpts are from the original agent trace.

chart_notes.error: ADD at aligned object poses, in path order. The object target stays fixed.
chart_notes.path: Object-center paths in the world XY plane. Height and orientation also contribute to ADD.
chart_notes.contact: Recorded object contact forces during execution. Robot contact and floor support are separate measurements.

stages.label: Trial 001
stages.quote: The first rollout kept the robot upright, but the grasp failed: the hand pushed the stand over instead of lifting it.
stages.full_message: The first rollout kept the robot upright, but the grasp failed: the hand pushed the stand over instead of lifting it. I’m inspecting the contact sequence and adjusting the finger closure and palm placement before testing the full carry again.
stages.revision: Adjust palm placement and finger closure

stages.label: Trial 002
stages.quote: The revised grasp lifted the stand briefly and reduced mean ADD to 0.353 m, but it slipped and lost rotational control.
stages.full_message: The revised grasp lifted the stand briefly and reduced mean ADD to 0.353 m, but it slipped and lost rotational control. The robot stayed upright. I’m testing a second hand on the pole to resist that rotation and maintain contact through the lift and turn.
stages.revision: Test a second hand to resist rotation

stages.label: Trial 006
stages.quote: I’m checking the endpoint and testing small feedback corrections to reduce the remaining tracking error.
stages.full_message: A firmer single-hand grip performed much better: mean ADD is 0.096 m, position error 0.074 m, and orientation error 11.6°. It maintained a continuous lift for about 3.1 seconds, with the robot upright throughout. I’m checking the endpoint and testing small feedback corrections to reduce the remaining tracking error.

stages.label: Final
stages.quote: The hand loses contact around 10 seconds, and the stand remains independently supported through the 14-second finish.
stages.full_message: The latest rollout completes the carry and sets the stand down without a fall or drop. Mean errors are 0.063 m ADD, 0.040 m position, and 7.70° orientation. The hand loses contact around 10 seconds, and the stand remains independently supported through the 14-second finish. I’m running the final reproducibility check and saving the submission.
stages.revision: Verify placement and save the reference
stages.image_label: Initial pose inspected before final submission
